params.name: waveform
params.description: Selects the oscillator shape, which sets the harmonic content of the raw tone before filtering.

params.name: cutoff
params.description: Sets the low-pass filter cutoff: harmonics above this frequency are attenuated, darkening the timbre.

params.name: resonance
params.description: Sets the filter Q, boosting energy near the cutoff and adding a nasal or ringing character.

params.name: attack
params.description: How long the amplitude envelope takes to rise from silence to peak after note-on.

params.name: decay
params.description: How long the envelope takes to fall from the peak down to the sustain level.

params.name: sustain
params.description: The held amplitude after decay, as a fraction of the peak, while the note is held.

params.name: release
params.description: How long the envelope takes to fall from the note-off level back to silence.

params.name: noise_level
params.description: Mixes in white noise, from a pure oscillator tone at 0 to a noisy texture at 0.5.
